019package org.apache.wiki.htmltowiki;
020
021import org.apache.wiki.api.core.Context;
022import org.apache.wiki.api.core.Engine;
023import org.htmlunit.cyberneko.parsers.SAXParser;
024import org.jdom2.Document;
025import org.jdom2.Element;
026import org.jdom2.JDOMException;
027import org.jdom2.input.SAXBuilder;
028import org.jdom2.input.sax.XMLReaderJDOMFactory;
029import org.jdom2.output.XMLOutputter;
030import org.xml.sax.Attributes;
031import org.xml.sax.SAXException;
032import org.xml.sax.XMLReader;
033import org.xml.sax.helpers.AttributesImpl;
034import org.xml.sax.helpers.XMLFilterImpl;
035
036import java.io.IOException;
037import java.io.StringReader;
038
039/**
040 * Converting Html to Wiki Markup with NekoHtml for converting html to xhtml and
041 * Xhtml2WikiTranslator for converting xhtml to Wiki Markup.
042 *
043 */
044public class HtmlStringToWikiTranslator {
045
046    /** Hands JDOM the HTML parser directly, as it would set SAX features on it that the parser does not know about. */
047    private static final XMLReaderJDOMFactory HTML_READER_FACTORY = new XMLReaderJDOMFactory() {
048        @Override
049        public XMLReader createXMLReader() {
050            return new AttributeUriFilter( new SAXParser() );
051        }
052
053        @Override
054        public boolean isValidating() {
055            return false;
056        }
057    };
058
059    private final Engine e;
060
061    /**
062     *  Create a new translator.
063     */
064    public HtmlStringToWikiTranslator( final Engine e ) {
065        this.e = e;
066    }
067
068    /**
069     *  Translates text from HTML into WikiMarkup without a WikiContext (meaning
070     *  some things perhaps cannot be translated).  Uses the default configuration.
071     *
072     *  @param html HTML text to translate
073     *  @return WikiMarkup
074     *
075     *  @throws JDOMException If parsing fails
076     *  @throws IOException For other kinds of errors.
077     */
078    public String translate( final String html ) throws JDOMException, IOException, ReflectiveOperationException {
079        return translate( html, new XHtmlToWikiConfig() );
080    }
081
082    /**
083     *  Translates text from HTML into WikiMarkup with a WikiContext.  The translation
084     *  accuracy is better.  Uses the default configuration.
085     *
086     *  @param html HTML text to translate
087     *  @param wikiContext The WikiContext to use.
088     *  @return WikiMarkup
089     *
090     *  @throws JDOMException If parsing fails
091     *  @throws IOException For other kinds of errors.
092     */
093    public String translate( final String html, final Context wikiContext ) throws JDOMException, IOException, ReflectiveOperationException {
094        return translate( html, new XHtmlToWikiConfig( wikiContext ) );
095    }
096
097    /**
098     *  Translates text from HTML into WikiMarkup using a specified configuration.
099     *
100     *  @param html HTML text to translate
101     *  @param config The configuration to use.
102     *  @return WikiMarkup
103     *
104     *  @throws JDOMException If parsing fails
105     *  @throws IOException For other kinds of errors.
106     */
107    public String translate( final String html, final XHtmlToWikiConfig config ) throws JDOMException, IOException, ReflectiveOperationException {
108        final Element element = htmlStringToElement( html );
109        final XHtmlElementToWikiTranslator xhtmlTranslator = new XHtmlElementToWikiTranslator( e, element, config );
110        return xhtmlTranslator.getWikiString();
111    }
112
113    /**
114     * Use NekoHtml to parse HTML like well-formed XHTML
115     *
116     * @param html HTML to parse.
117     * @return xhtml jdom root element (node "html")
118     * @throws JDOMException when errors occur in parsing
119     * @throws IOException when an I/O error prevents a document from being fully parsed
120     */
121    private Element htmlStringToElement( final String html ) throws JDOMException, IOException {
122        final SAXBuilder builder = new SAXBuilder( HTML_READER_FACTORY, null, null );
123        //builder.setProperty( XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD, "" );
124        //builder.setProperty( XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA, "" );
125        final Document doc = builder.build( new StringReader( html ) );
126        return doc.getRootElement();
127    }
128
129    /**
130     *  A static helper method to create HTML from an Element.
131     *
132     *  @param element The element to get HTML from.
133     *  @return HTML
134     */
135    public static String element2String( final Element element ) {
136        final Document document = new Document( element );
137        final XMLOutputter outputter = new XMLOutputter();
138        return outputter.outputString( document );
139    }
140
141    /**
142     *  The HTML parser reports {@code null} as the namespace URI of the attributes, where the SAX contract says it is the empty string,
143     *  and JDOM cannot handle that.
144     */
145    private static final class AttributeUriFilter extends XMLFilterImpl {
146
147        AttributeUriFilter( final XMLReader parent ) {
148            super( parent );
149        }
150
151        @Override
152        public void startElement( final String uri, final String localName, final String qName, final Attributes atts ) throws SAXException {
153            final AttributesImpl attributes = new AttributesImpl( atts );
154            for( int i = 0; i < attributes.getLength(); i++ ) {
155                if( attributes.getURI( i ) == null ) {
156                    attributes.setURI( i, "" );
157                }
158            }
159            super.startElement( uri, localName, qName, attributes );
160        }
161
162    }
163
164}
